# Shenyang Kaixin Technology Co., Ltd. - Rice Husk Chopping Boards

> A specialist manufacturer of rice husk chopping boards, based in Shenyang, China.
> Natural, coloured and anti-slip boards for retail brands, Amazon sellers and kitchenware
> distributors in the UK, Australia and New Zealand. B2B only: no online checkout and no
> published price list. Contact: alina@kaixinkeji.cn | WhatsApp +86 159 4024 0352.

## Boards
- [Natural Rice Husk Chopping Board](https://www.ricehuskchoppingboard.com/products/natural-rice-husk-chopping-board.html): two sizes, natural colour, dense knife-friendly surface.
- [Coloured / Pantone Chopping Board](https://www.ricehuskchoppingboard.com/products/coloured-rice-husk-chopping-board.html): any Pantone colour, three sizes, juice groove, silicone ring and hanging hole.
- [Silicone Ring Chopping Board](https://www.ricehuskchoppingboard.com/products/silicone-ring-chopping-board.html): continuous anti-slip silicone ring on the underside.
- [Anti-Slip Dots Chopping Board](https://www.ricehuskchoppingboard.com/products/silicone-dots-chopping-board.html): four curved anti-slip silicone bars at the back corners.
